up: List all compounds that are reported in the document with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL5244202. For each compound, provide its ChEMBL ID, its name (pref_name), the maximum development phase (max_phase), the molecule type (molecule_type), and the canonical SMILES. Sort the results by the compound ChEMBL ID in ascending order.
sql: WITH doc AS (SELECT doc_id FROM docs WHERE chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5244202'), compounds_in_doc AS (SELECT DISTINCT molregno FROM compound_records cr JOIN doc ON cr.doc_id = doc.doc_id WHERE molregno IS NOT NULL) SELECT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, md.max_phase, md.molecule_type, cs.canonical_smiles FROM compounds_in_doc cid JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cid.molregno = md.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON cid.molregno = cs.molregno ORDER BY md.chembl_id ASC;
